description: Round 1 castle shaft: a ladder jump (PgUp), then Up held to the castle top and the end screen (ega/099-101; ega_castle_ladder_jump_top.avi fits these keys within a tick)

avi_fits.note: 1.2 ticks at the castle-top transition: DOSBox-X shows the shaft until the transition frame has loaded CLOSE and drawn, the engine from its start
avi_fits.wave5: wave 5 (frame order): a short frame's picture now shows from the tick that changed it, a long one's (a scroll step: 6.5-7.5 PIT ticks) from the tick after; in the trunk-climb AVI recorded with r2/fl_climb the climb's sprite steps and scroll steps now both fall on the fitted time base (mean offsets -0.16 and 0.00 ticks; before -0.81 and +0.09). In the castle AVIs the end sequence's animation frames appear about as late after their ticks as the scroll steps (relative offsets: before +0.2, now -0.8 ticks in ega_r2_end_t2_nokey.avi, recorded with r2/fl_end_t2_wait, whose ticks the engine matches one for one): those frames (several large sprites drawn and presented) last about 6 PIT ticks on the reference machine, which no log measures yet (the FRAME ring of r2/fl_end_t2_wait holds only the rank screen); not modelled, so the fit keeps 53 frames off it, at most 1.06 ticks (wave 4: 24)
